title: 第2章 死亡结算，功力上涨
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
时间一点点流逝。

    赵三的呼吸越来越微弱。

    终于。

    “咯喽……”

    赵三喉咙里发出最后一声怪响，脑袋一歪，彻底没了动静。

    一代采花大盗，就此落幕。

    死得毫无尊严，甚至有点草率。

    陈然依旧没动，保持着一种“敌不动我不动”的姿态，主打一个稳健。

    直到赵三头顶的文字发生变化，像游戏里的系统提示一样闪烁起来。

    【犯人赵三已死亡】

    【参与度结算中……】

    【参与度：极低】

    【获得奖励：三个月功力。】

    轰。

    又是一股热流涌入体内。

    虽然不如之前的一年功力那么庞大，但也让陈然刚稳固的境界又精进了一分。

    陈然握了握拳，感受着体内涌动的力量。

    蚊子腿也是肉啊！

    只是说了几句话，看着他死，就能白捡三个月苦修。

    这买卖，简直是一本万利！

    要是换成前身，还得苦哈哈地练上三个月，还不一定能练出个屁来。

    “白嫖使我快乐。”

    陈然嘴角微扬，心情愉悦。

    若是……

    陈然看着赵三僵硬的尸体，若有所思。

    若是刚才自己答应帮他送信，或者……亲手送他上路？

    奖励会不会更多？

    甚至，能不能得到他那身引以为傲的轻功？

    毕竟系统提示里说了，“参与度”越高，奖励越丰厚。

    陈然舔了舔干裂的嘴唇，

    这天牢对他来说，不再是阴森恐怖的死地。

    而是一座巨大的、等待开发的自助餐厅！

    只要苟得住，遍地是黄金。

    “陈然！发什么呆！”

    巡逻的狱卒走过来，用刀鞘敲了敲栅栏，发出刺耳的金属撞击声。

    是同僚张文，这名字起得就很路人甲。
content_en:
Time passes little by little.

    Zhao San's breathing became weaker and weaker.

    finally.

    "Here we go..."

    Zhao San made a last strange sound in his throat, tilted his head, and there was no movement at all.

    This is the end of a generation of flower-picking thieves.

    It was an undignified death, even a bit hasty.

    Chen Ran still didn't move, maintaining a posture of "if the enemy doesn't move, I won't move", focusing on stability.

    Until the text above Zhao San's head changed and flickered like a system prompt in a game.

    [Prisoner Zhao San has died]

    [Participation settlement is in progress...]

    [Participation: extremely low]

    [Reward: Three months of skill. 】

    Boom.

    Another wave of heat poured into his body.

    Although his skill is not as great as the previous year, it has made Chen Rangang's stable state even better.

    Chen Ran clenched his fist, feeling the power surging within his body.

    Mosquito legs are also meat!

    Just say a few words and watch him die, and three months of hard training can be wasted.

    This deal is a huge profit!

    If it were the predecessor, he would still have to practice hard for three months, and he might not be able to do anything.

    "Whoring for free makes me happy."

    Chen Ran raised the corners of his mouth slightly, feeling happy.

    If...

    Chen Ran looked at Zhao San's stiff corpse, thoughtfully.

    What if I had just promised to help him deliver the letter, or...send him on his way with his own hands?

    Will there be more rewards?

    Can he even get the lightness skill that he is so proud of?

    After all, the system prompts say that the higher the "participation", the more generous the reward will be.

    Chen Ran licked his chapped lips,

    To him, this prison was no longer a terrifying place of death.

    But a huge cafeteria waiting to be developed!

    As long as you can survive, there will be gold everywhere.

    "Chen Ran! What are you doing?"

    The patrolling jailer came over and knocked on the fence with his scabbard, making a sharp metal impact.

    It's my colleague Zhang Wen, and his name is very popular.
